description: This file defines the ProductPriceDescription class, which extends Description and represents localized descriptions for product prices in the system. It is an entity mapped to the PRODUCT_PRICE_DESCRIPTION table, with relationships to ProductPrice, and enforces unique constraints on product price and language identifiers.
